DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Pillar of Frost and Empower Rune Weapon are active during their burst window
  • They are using Breath of Sindragosa and their runic power pool is stable for maximum uptime
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • Gargoyle is active and has 22 seconds or less remaining.
  • The DK is using Army of the Dead (without Gargoyle) with either Raise Abomination active for under 18 seconds or Army Ghouls with 18 seconds or less remaining.
  • The DK isn’t using Summon Gargoyle or Army of the Dead, and Dark Transformation is active.
  • Dark Transformation is active while the DK isn’t using Summon Gargoyle (regardless of other talents).
  • Gargoyle is inactive, and the next Summon Gargoyle cooldown won’t overlap Power Infusion’s duration.
  • Facing 3+ enemies during Dark Transformation or while Death and Decay is active.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They activate Metamorphosis (their primary DPS cooldown), as this amplifies their burst damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds, to maximize the buff’s uptime before combat concludes.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their cooldowns align and they do not have the TWW3 Keeper 4-piece set bonus active.
  • They have the TWW3 Keeper 4-piece set bonus and are entering either a single Celestial Alignment phase or a double Celestial Alignment phase.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid has an active Berserk: Heart of the Lion buff, aligning with their major cooldown window.
  • The Feral Druid does not have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent, allowing for flexible usage outside their modified Berserk window.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Their Dragonrage is active and at least one of the following is true: Shattering Star is on cooldown, the Shattering Star debuff is present on the target, or there are 2 or more enemies.
  • The fight will end in less than 35 seconds and you won’t get another opportunity to use it.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The Hunter's Trueshot buff has over 12 seconds remaining, ensuring maximum alignment with their primary damage window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, allowing Power Infusion to cover the final burst phase before combat concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with over 7 seconds remaining, and Power Infusion isn’t already active.
  • The Hunter does not have Coordinated Assault talented, and Spearhead is ready to use (untalented CA build).
  • The Hunter has neither Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead talented (non-standard build).
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They have just cast Arcane Surge (immediately after the spell finishes its global cooldown), as this aligns with their primary damage window.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active, Combustion has more than 6 seconds remaining, and you want to align with their burst window.
  • Power Infusion is not active and the encounter will end within 25 seconds to maximize final damage output before the fight concludes.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • They are activating major cooldowns like Icy Veins and Power Infusion is not already active.
  • Power Infusion is available and not currently applied to the Mage, aligning with their burst damage phases.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Their Xuen the White Tiger pet is active and either of these conditions holds:
  • Bloodlust is not active (to avoid stacking with its haste effects).
  • Bloodlust is active and Strike of the Windlord is on cooldown (to align with their next major ability).
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • They activate Avenging Wrath, their core 2-minute damage cooldown.
  • They use Crusade (if talented), as this stacking damage buff combos with haste effects.
  • Their target is affected by Execution Sentence, especially as the debuff nears its final burst damage.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when the following conditions are met and Power Infusion is not already active:

  • Voidform is active.
  • Dark Ascension is active.
  • Their tier set bonus (TWW 2pc) is active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Deathmark is actively dealing damage to their target, as this aligns with their strongest damage window.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has Shadow Dance active, as this coincides with their primary burst window where they maximize damage with Stealth-enabled abilities.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • The Elemental Shaman has Ascendance actively activated, boosting their burst damage phase.
  • Ascendance’s cooldown has more than 30 seconds remaining, ensuring it won’t come off cooldown soon, allowing optimal timing without overlapping major cooldowns.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • The Shaman has Deeply Rooted Elements talented and their Ascendance buff has more than 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • The Shaman does not have Deeply Rooted Elements and is using one of these cooldowns: Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds of Power Infusion’s cooldown reset (every 2 minutes).
  • The Shaman’s shortest remaining major cooldown is at least 120 seconds away.
  • The Shaman hasn’t talented into any of their primary offensive cooldowns (Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Soul Rot is active, amplifying their periodic damage effects
  • Their other major cooldowns (like Summon Darkglare) are active and requiring burst damage
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The warlock's Imp Gang Boss will despawn within 6 seconds plus your maximum GCD duration and spell cast time
  • The Imp Gang Boss despawn timer aligns with a damage window to maximize haste-boosted imp attacks
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Infernal is currently active, enhancing their burst window.
  • They do not have the Summon Infernal talent selected, requiring alignment with general cooldowns.
  • The encounter will end before their Infernal is available again plus 10 seconds (adjusted for Power Infusion’s 20s duration) but lasts long enough to utilize the full buff.
  • The encounter will end within 15 seconds of their next potential Infernal cooldown, preventing wasted usage.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • the target has Colossus Smash applied and the encounter has over 135 seconds remaining.
  • during the Execute phase (target below 20% health) while the Warrior has Avatar active.
  • the encounter has 25 seconds or less remaining to maximize final burst.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar (Recklessness) has over 15 seconds remaining AND the encounter lasts longer than 135 seconds.
  • The target is in Execute phase (below 20% health) AND Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
